status.scanDone: Scan finished: {{count}} files — Build the plan
status.planReady: Plan ready: {{move}} moves, {{quarantine}} to quarantine — Review

placeholder.title: This screen is coming soon
placeholder.body: Döndü is being built step by step.

folders.title: Folders
folders.intro: Döndü only looks at the folders you choose. Scanning never touches files; nothing moves without your approval.
folders.emptyBody: Add the folders you want to tidy, such as Desktop, Downloads or Documents.

rejected.system: This is a system folder and cannot be selected.
rejected.app: Döndü's own data folder cannot be selected.
rejected.nested: It is already inside a selected folder.

check.cloudHint: This folder syncs with the cloud. Files that are not downloaded are left alone and shown separately in the report.

problem.missing: This folder no longer exists or has moved.
problem.read: This folder cannot be read. Check its permissions.
problem.readMac: macOS did not allow access to this folder — open Privacy settings to grant it.
problem.write: This folder is not writable. Scanning works, but applying a plan needs write access.
problem.writeWin: Windows Security may be blocking writes here (Ransomware protection). Scanning works.

scan.title: Scan
scan.readOnly: Scanning is read-only: nothing is moved or changed.
scan.emptyBody_one: Scan {{count}} folder to see a summary here.
scan.emptyBody_other: Scan {{count}} folders to see a summary here.
scan.noFolders: First choose the folders to tidy.
scan.cancelled: The scan was stopped. The summary below shows what was found until then.
scan.cloudSkipped_one: Note: {{count}} file is in the cloud and not downloaded; I left it alone.
scan.cloudSkipped_other: Note: {{count}} files are in the cloud and not downloaded; I left them alone.

errors.scan_failed: The scan could not be completed.
errors.plan_not_draft: An approved plan cannot change; make a copy first.
errors.target_outside_roots: The target must be inside the selected folders.
errors.ai_failed: The AI step did not work; the plan was built with rules only.
errors.trash_failed: Could not send to the trash.

estimate.title: AI estimate
estimate.nothing: The rules classified everything; no AI needed.
estimate.line: {{files}} files will be sent to AI · ~{{tokens}} tokens · ~{{usd}}
estimate.cached_one: {{count}} file is cached; no charge again.
estimate.cached_other: {{count}} files are cached; no charge again.
estimate.images_one: {{count}} file is sent with a small preview.
estimate.images_other: {{count}} files are sent with a small preview.
estimate.overUsd: The estimate exceeds the per-run limit ({{limit}}).
estimate.overTokens: The estimate exceeds the per-run token limit ({{limit}}).
estimate.overHint: Lower the image resolution or send only uncertain files.
estimate.privacy: Sensitive files are never sent to the cloud.

report.title: Report
report.emptyBody: Scan first, then build the plan.

locked.approved: This plan is approved and can no longer change. Make a copy to edit it.
locked.applied: This plan was applied. Open History to undo it.
locked.partial: This plan was partly applied. Details in History.

report.aiFailed: Some batches did not answer; those files were planned with rules.

group.cloud: In the cloud, not downloaded — left alone

report.learnHint: If you change the category, Döndü remembers your choice for files like this.
report.markSensitiveHint: Sensitive files are never sent to the cloud.

folderDialog.title: Change target folder
folderDialog.body_one: {{count}} file will go to this folder.
folderDialog.body_other: {{count}} files will go to this folder.
folderDialog.label: Folder inside {{root}}

approve.title: Apply now?
approve.counts: {{move}} files will move, {{rename}} will be renamed, {{quarantine}} duplicates go to quarantine, {{skip}} files stay untouched.
approve.promise: Döndü never deletes anything. Duplicates go to the Döndü Karantina folder; everything can be undone from History.
approve.trashWarn_one: {{count}} file goes to the system trash; you would restore it from there by hand.
approve.trashWarn_other: {{count}} files go to the system trash; you would restore them from there by hand.
approve.double: This is a big change: {{count}} files. Are you sure?
approve.issuesBody_one: {{count}} file changed after the scan or cannot be used right now. I can continue without touching it.
approve.issuesBody_other: {{count}} files changed after the scan or cannot be used right now. I can continue without touching them.

apply.title: Applying
apply.errorStopped: Something went wrong with a file; I stopped.
apply.doneMsg: {{done}} files placed, {{failed}} skipped. To undo: History → this run → Undo.

history.title: History
history.emptyBody: Every plan you apply is listed here and can be undone.
history.changedWarn_one: {{count}} file changed after it was moved; I left it alone.
history.changedWarn_other: {{count}} files changed after they were moved; I left them alone.
history.trashed_one: {{count}} file went to the trash; please restore it from Trash by hand:
history.trashed_other: {{count}} files went to the trash; please restore them from Trash by hand:
history.forceBody_one: {{count}} file was changed after Döndü moved it. Move it back anyway?
history.forceBody_other: {{count}} files were changed after Döndü moved them. Move them back anyway?

quarantine.reminder: Files have waited in quarantine for {{days}} days ({{size}}). Empty it?
quarantine.confirmBody: The quarantine folder goes to the system trash, where you can still restore it. Döndü never deletes directly.

recovery.title: An unfinished operation was found
recovery.body: An operation started on {{date}} did not finish (the app may have closed). I restored its state from the journal.
recovery.safe: No file was lost; every step is in the journal.
